items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: No, me and Remus played together with John Cassidy.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Hey boys. I was gonna ask you, did you ever play with the Matthews brothers, Bebe or Remus very much? You mentioned Bebe.
No, me and Remus played together with John Cassidy.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I played in the church, I played the trumpet, he played the drum.

ctx.x: Did he play in the church? Somebody told me he played in the church. Yeah, he played in the church.

Yeah, I meet him, look, every time I meet him, he's working on the ferry boat, you see. And every time I cross on the ferry boat, he says, sir, sir kid, when you coming up? I said, well, first chance I get, I said, I'm coming up. So once, two Sundays I went. I played in the church, I played the trumpet, he played the drum. Later played the piano. And a fellow played the guitar, electric guitar. He played nice, nice, nice guitar too. And I mean, he had really nice church, but I enjoyed it, you know? So, I played…
I remember you told me once about how they-

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: So, Remus told me one day when he was coming across, he said, you know, big kid, he said, I believe I'm going to change my way of living.

ctx.x: Were you a regular member or just once a while?

I was a regular member in John's band. Yeah. Yeah, I just got out after them fellas man, that fellas that like the auger too much, you know what I mean? Had a fella that he like the auger, man and Gabbert, he said, I like the auger so much, you know. So, I got this guy, me and this boy Albert, you know. Told me Albert's son. Yeah, Lutcher. Lutcher. So, we got out. Not, he was playing with him, and Remus Maschews, Bill Maschews, brother, you know. So, Remus told me one day when he was coming across, he said, you…

We better stop here, we got to do a little with Manuel Paul. Yeah, yeah, yeah. So, thank you very much. Okay. Okay, what's your name? Emmanuel Paul. Yeah, where were you born? In New Orleans, Louisiana. Mm-hmm. And, uh, excuse me. Oh, God, I'm sorry. Uh, what year? Time, exactly. Ah, February the 2nd, 1904. Mm-hmm. Uh, did anybody in your family play music? No, no one in the family. Mm-hmm. Well, how'd you get interested in it? Well, through friends. As a youngster? As a youngster, in my teenage. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.…
